collection.title: Subaru Outback 2021 to 2026 windscreen Wiper Blades
collection.description: The Subaru Outback 2021 Onwards model requires a 26" wiper blade on the drivers side and a 16" blade on the passengers side and all of the following wiper blades are designed to fit this vehicle. The type of wiper arm fitting for this model is the Notched Push Button arm attachment.
